worked.problem: A grouped survey uses equal-width intervals from 5≤x<15 through 45≤x<55. Frequencies in order: [4, 7, 13, 7, 5]. Draw a histogram and frequency polygon; identify the modal interval.
actions: The class boundaries [5, 15, 25, 35, 45, 55] define the horizontal positions; each frequency determines a bar height.
Draw five touching histogram bars of width 10, heights [4, 7, 13, 7, 5].
Mark the midpoint of each bar top at [10, 20, 30, 40, 50].
Join the midpoint points to form the frequency polygon; the largest frequency is 13.
Answer: Modal interval = 25≤x<35, because its bar and polygon peak have frequency 13.
worked.check: Answer: Modal interval = 25≤x<35, because its bar and polygon peak have frequency 13.

Draw five touching histogram bars of width 10, heights [4, 6, 13, 7, 5].
Mark the midpoint of each bar top at [20, 30, 40, 50, 60].
Join the midpoint points to form the frequency polygon; the largest frequency is 13.
Answer: Modal interval = 35≤x<45, because its bar and polygon peak have frequency 13.
